title: 第10章：末日里的桃花源？
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

合金房车在G50高速上平稳巡航，时速一百。

周建国坐在新加的铺位上，手还在摸着金属车厢内壁，眼神跟做梦一样。

系统面板在林昊面前弹开。

一张区域地图展开，两条路线被高亮显示。

一条是红色，是沿着G50继续向前。

另一条是黄色，是从前方的立交桥岔出去。

【区域概况分析......】

【路线一（红色）：继续沿G50高速行驶148公里，抵达中型城镇“枫林镇”。物资等级：高。危险等级：高。预计遭遇大规模尸潮概率：85%。可能发现LV3升级关键材料。】

【路线二（黄色）：前方39公里处转入S207省道，行驶55公里，抵达“青山镇安置点”（信息来源：无线电广播）。物资等级：未知。危险等级：未知。】

“去安置点！必须去安置点！”

王德发第一个从角落里跳起来，声音尖得刺耳。

“有围墙！有食物！有组织！广播里都说了！还往前瞎跑什么？去那个枫林镇送死吗？”

苏晴抱着妞妞，也看向林昊，眼神里是恳求。

“林昊，孩子需要一个稳定的地方，哪怕只是暂时的。”

车厢里安静下来。

周建国低着头，不敢说话。

陈明和李小雨交换了一个眼神，也没开口。

所有人的目光都集中在林昊身上。

赵铁柱靠在副驾驶座上，擦着猎枪，他没有回头，但咬牙的面部动作显示出他此刻内心的焦灼。

林昊手指在地图上划了一下，把两条路线的风险收益比放大。

红色和黄色，在他视网膜里跳动。

“任何安置点都不是绝对安全的。”林昊开口，声音不大，但压住了王德发的躁动，“我们对青山镇一无所知。广播可能是真的，也可能是陷阱。”

“那也比一头扎进丧尸堆里强！”王德发反驳。

“但枫林镇，有我们必须拿到的东西。”林昊的目光扫过系统面板上LV3升级所需的材料列表。

他沉默了半分钟。

然后他做出了决定。

“这样，我们先去青山镇。”

王德发的脸上瞬间露出喜色。

“但只是去看看。”林昊的下一句话，让他脸上的笑容瞬间僵住。

“确认安全，可以补给，可以休整。但那里不是终点。”

他回头，看着车厢里的每一个人。

“这辆车，才是我们唯一的家。“

“让它变得更强，我们才能活得更久。大家都

他关掉地图，私下给赵铁柱发了条信息，只有两人能看见的系统短讯。

“任何人都不能完全信任，安置点也一样。我们的目标不变，找到真相。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The alloy RV cruises smoothly on the G50 highway at a speed of 100 per hour.

Zhou Jianguo sat on the newly added bunk, his hands still touching the inner wall of the metal carriage, his eyes looking like he was dreaming.

The system panel popped up in front of Lin Hao.

A map of the area expands and two routes are highlighted.

One is red and continues along G50.

The other one is yellow and branches off from the overpass in front.

[Regional overview analysis...]

[Route 1 (red): Continue driving along the G50 highway for 148 kilometers and arrive at the medium-sized town "Fenglin Town".Material level: high.Hazard level: high.Estimated probability of encountering a large-scale zombie wave: 85%.Key materials for LV3 upgrade may be found.】

[Route 2 (yellow): 39 kilometers ahead, turn onto S207 Provincial Highway, drive 55 kilometers, and arrive at the "Qingshan Town Resettlement Site" (information source: radio broadcast).Material level: unknown.Hazard level: unknown.】

"Go to the resettlement site! Must go to the resettlement site!"

Wang Defa was the first to jump up from the corner, his voice shrill.

"There's a wall! There's food! There's an organization! It's all said on the radio! Why are you still running around? Are you going to die in Maplewood Town?"

Su Qing hugged Niu Niu and looked at Lin Hao with pleading eyes.

"Lin Hao, the child needs a stable place, even if it's just temporary."

The carriage fell silent.

Zhou Jianguo lowered his head and did not dare to speak.

Chen Ming and Li Xiaoyu exchanged glances without speaking.

Everyone's eyes were focused on Lin Hao.

Zhao Tiezhu leaned on the passenger seat and wiped the shotgun. He did not look back, but his facial movements of gritting his teeth showed his inner anxiety at the moment.

Lin Hao drew a finger on the map to enlarge the risk-benefit ratio of the two routes.

Red and yellow danced in his retinas.

"No resettlement site is absolutely safe." Lin Hao spoke, his voice was not loud, but he suppressed Wang Defa's restlessness, "We know nothing about Qingshan Town. The broadcast may be true, or it may be a trap."

"That's better than diving into a pile of zombies!" Wang Defa retorted.

"But there is something we must get in Maplewood Town." Lin Hao's eyes scanned the list of materials required for LV3 upgrade on the system panel.

He was silent for half a minute.

Then he made his decision.

"In this case, let's go to Qingshan Town first."

Wang Defa's face instantly showed joy.

"But just to take a look." Lin Hao's next words made the smile on his face freeze instantly.

"It's confirmed that it's safe, we can resupply, and we can rest. But that's not the end."

He turned around and looked at everyone in the carriage.

"This car is our only home."

“Make it stronger so we can live longer. Everybody

He turned off the map and privately sent a message to Zhao Tiezhu, a system text message that only the two of them could see.

“No one can be completely trusted, not even the settlements.Our goal remains the same, to find the truth."
